parsed.summary: The change correctly updates the regex to reject invalid characters in the username and password, but it may introduce unintended side effects.

issues.description: The updated regex may inadvertently break existing URLs that were previously valid but now contain disallowed characters in the username or password.
The change could be more readable with additional comments explaining the regex update.
